name: Lady Lake
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Lady Lake?
answer_short: Yes. In Lady Lake, golf carts use the multi-modal paths and streets the county or city has designated, but not roads posted 35 mph or more. Street-legal LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less. Cross US 27/441, US 301 and SR 44 only at tunnels, bridges or signed crossings.

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Lady Lake?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and tagged; multi-modal paths allowed. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Do I need a license to drive a golf cart in Lady Lake?
faq.a: Florida requires golf cart drivers on public roads to be at least 14; LSV drivers need a valid driver's license and the LSV must be registered and insured.

faq.q: Can golf carts use roads posted 35 mph in Lady Lake?
faq.a: No. The District's rules prohibit golf carts on roadways posted 35 mph or more; use the multi-modal paths, tunnels and bridges instead.
